skills.name: Snow Cut (雪立•裁)
skills.line: This snow becomes my blade, carving out new hope.
skills.description: Yuki Gozen attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Gentian: Bloom (龙胆•绽)
skills.line: When the flowers finish blooming, the wind and snow come knocking.
skills.description:
For every single-target attack gain 1 stack of Snowy Edge. When defeating a non-summoned enemy, Yuki Gozen summons Gentian Glass at their Move Bar. When Gentian Glass acts, glass blades deals damage equal to 50% of Gentian Glass's max HP when striking the enemy with the lowest HP.
When casting, Gentian Glass is summoned. ; : ;Snowy Edge (巫灵雪刃) : :'''General, Mark''': Can stack up to three times, when casting Snow Slash, consumes 2 stacks to evolve the next blade strike into Snow Burst that deals 88% ATK damage to all enemies. ;Gentian Glass (龙胆蓝璃) :Immune to debuff and control effects. HP is equal to 240% of Yuki Gozen's starting ATK. When summoned, it inherits Yuki Gozen's CRIT, CRIT DMG, DEF and 95% of her SPD. When resummoned, max HP increases by 39% of starting ATK (up to 3 times) and fully restores HP.

upgrades.text: Raises Gentian Glass's HP to 280% of starting ATK.
Raises Gentian Glass's HP to 320% of starting ATK.
Raises Gentian Glass's HP to 360% of starting ATK.
At the start of battle, summons Gentian Glass.

skills.name: Snow Slash (千雪•斩)
skills.line: With this blade in hang, I protect every soul returning home.
skills.description: 9 slashes are unleashed at the selected enemy target, each slash deals damage equal to 18% of ATK. ;Snowy Edge (巫灵雪刃) : :'''General, Mark''': Can stack up to three times, when casting Snow Slash, consumes 2 stacks to evolve the next blade strike into Snow Burst that deals 88% ATK damage to all enemies.

upgrades.text: Blade strike damage increases to 27% of ATK.
Snowy Edge increases Snow Burst's damage to 108% of ATK.
Snow Burst's damage taken by selected enemy target is increased by 50%.
If the target is defeated, the enemy with the lowest HP is targeted next.
